statement: K5-e marked-cross-edge (a,b) component theorem. On c=d=e=1, with beta=-1+sqrt(10)/4, the complete component of P>0 containing (1,1) is exactly a>beta and b>-C(a)/A(a); xi is strictly positive throughout it.
closes: complete distinguished-component classification and strict xi positivity on the natural c=d=e=1, free-(a,b) slice
